exposure: elevated fasting plasma glucose (FPG) prior to delivery
outcome: abnormal postpartum glucose results (impaired fasting glucose, impaired glucose tolerance, suspected diabetes)
cohort: The study included 3047 women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) from West China Second Hospital, Sichuan University.
finding: Higher pregestational BMI, multiparity, ART use, excessive gestational weight gain, elevated pre-delivery FPG, and undergoing cesarean section were independently associated with non-compliance to postpartum glucose follow-up screening.
mod_finding: Undergoing cesarean section was identified as an independent factor associated with non-compliance to postpartum glucose follow-up screening.
